title: SEPS: Semantic-enhanced Patch Slimming Framework for fine-grained cross-modal alignment
abstract: arXiv:2511.01390v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Fine-grained cross-modal alignment aims to establish precise local correspondences between vision and language, forming a cornerstone for visual question answering and related multimodal applications. Current approaches face challenges in addressing patch redundancy and ambiguity, which arise from the inherent information density disparities across modalities. Recently, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have emerged as promising solutions to bridge this gap through their robust semantic generation capabilities. However, the dense textual outputs from MLLMs may introduce conflicts with the original sparse captions. Furthermore, accurately quantifying semantic relevance between rich visual patches and concise textual descriptions remains a core challenge. translated_title: SEPS：面向细粒度跨模态对齐的语义增强补丁瘦身框架
translated_abstract: 细粒度跨模态对齐旨在建立视觉与语言之间精确的局部对应关系，是视觉问答及相关多模态应用的基石。当前方法在解决补丁冗余和歧义问题上面临挑战，这些问题源于模态间固有的信息密度差异。近年来，多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）凭借其强大的语义生成能力成为弥合这一差距的有前景的解决方案。然而，MLLMs产生的密集文本输出可能与原始稀疏的图像描述产生冲突。此外，如何准确量化丰富的视觉补丁与简洁的文本描述之间的语义相关性仍然是一个核心挑战。为克服这些局限，我们提出了语义增强补丁瘦身（SEPS）框架，系统性地解决补丁冗余和歧义问题。
tldr: 提出语义增强补丁瘦身（SEPS）框架，通过系统性解决视觉补丁的冗余与歧义问题，实现视觉与语言之间精确的细粒度跨模态对齐。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SEPS, a Semantic-enhanced Patch Slimming framework that systematically addresses patch redundancy and ambiguity to achieve precise fine-grained cross-modal alignment between vision and language.
